```yaml
name: Build Test Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: false
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build_image
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          use-custom-docker-registry: false
          docker-image-name: opendata-oss/opendata
          docker-build-dir: .
          docker-build-timeout-minutes: 30
          custom-tag-prefix: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          working-directory: .
          docker-registry: ghcr.io
          always-rebuild: true
          push: true
          force-push: true
          repo-name: opendata-oss/opendata
          ci-docker-hash: ${{ github.sha }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Image built
        run: echo "Docker image ${{ steps.build_image.outputs.docker-image }} built and pushed."
```
